meta.title: Tossa + Blanes Vlog | 漫游西班牙08
meta.topic: 旅行Vlog · 西班牙 · 托萨与布拉内斯

scenes.title_cn: 开场：海岸线上的中世纪防御
scenes.title_en: Opening: A Medieval Defensive Town on the Coast
scenes.context: 博主介绍今天来到加泰罗尼亚海岸线上唯一幸存的中世纪防御海堡，以及让仙人掌和热带植物当邻居的植物园。语域：旅行开场。
sentences: 今天我们来到的是加泰罗尼亚海岸线上唯一幸存的中世纪防御海堡。
Today we're at the only surviving medieval defensive stronghold on the Catalonia coast.
medieval defensive stronghold（中世纪防御海堡）；the only surviving（唯一幸存）
还有让仙人掌和热带植物当邻居的植物园。
And a botanical garden where cacti and tropical plants live as neighbors.
botanical garden（植物园）；live as neighbors（当邻居）
因为我的包不是被抢了吗，所以我这次只能被Sephora送的包了。
Since my bag was stolen, this time I can only use the free bag Sephora gave me.
the free bag Sephora gave me（丝芙兰送的包）
paraphrase: 唯一幸存 → the only surviving / the only one left
the only surviving · the only one left
当邻居 → live as neighbors / growing side by side
live as neighbors · side by side
scenes.speak: Today we're at the only surviving medieval defensive stronghold on the Catalonia coast. And a botanical garden where cacti and tropical plants live as neighbors. Since my bag was stolen, this time I can only use the free bag Sephora gave me.

scenes.title_cn: 仙人掌与雨林植物：看似不可能的共存
scenes.title_en: Cacti & Rainforest Plants: An Impossible Coexistence
scenes.context: 植物园把来自五大洲的4000多种植物搬进同一座花园，一边是怕积水爱晒太阳的仙人掌，一边是喜湿的热带雨林植物。语域：科普讲解。
sentences: 一边是来自干旱地区喜欢晒太阳、又害怕积水的仙人掌。
On one side, cacti from dry regions that love the sun and hate standing water.
hate standing water（害怕积水）；from dry regions（来自干旱地区）
一边是来自热带雨林的喜湿植物。
On the other side, moisture-loving plants from the tropical rainforest.
moisture-loving plants（喜湿植物）
植物园的创始人利用这里临海悬崖的特殊环境，把来自五大洲的4000多种植物类群搬进了同一座花园。
The founder used the unique cliffside-by-the-sea environment to bring over four thousand plant groups from five continents into one garden.
cliffside environment（临海悬崖环境）；plant groups from five continents（来自五大洲的植物类群）
paraphrase: 喜欢晒太阳 → love the sun / sun-loving
love the sun · sun-loving
害怕积水 → hate standing water / can't stand wet roots
hate standing water · wet roots
scenes.speak: On one side, cacti from dry regions that love the sun and hate standing water. On the other side, moisture-loving plants from the tropical rainforest. The founder used the unique cliffside-by-the-sea environment to bring over four thousand plant groups from five continents into one garden.

scenes.title_cn: 为什么能共存：悬崖、海风与岩石
scenes.title_en: Why It Works: Cliff, Sea Breeze & Rock
scenes.context: 博主解释共存原理：悬崖排水快不积水；海风带来湿润空气滋养雨林植物；岩石白天吸热晚上释放形成天然温室；山坡树林削弱强风。语域：科普分点讲解。
sentences: 下雨后水会顺着斜坡快速流走，不容易积在土壤里。
After rain, water runs quickly down the slope, so it doesn't pool in the soil.
run down the slope（顺斜坡流走）；pool in the soil（积在土壤里）
海风又会带着湿润的空气，让喜湿的热带雨林植物也能生长。
The sea breeze carries moist air, letting the moisture-loving rainforest plants thrive.
carry moist air（带着湿润空气）；thrive（茁壮生长）
岩石在白天吸收太阳的能量，慢慢释放出来，形成了一个天然的温室。
The rocks absorb the sun's energy during the day and release it slowly, creating a natural greenhouse.
absorb energy（吸收能量）；a natural greenhouse（天然的温室）
paraphrase: 不积水 → doesn't pool / drains away / no standing water
doesn't pool · drains away
天然温室 → a natural greenhouse / nature's own greenhouse effect
natural greenhouse
scenes.speak: After rain, water runs quickly down the slope, so it doesn't pool in the soil. The sea breeze carries moist air, letting the moisture-loving rainforest plants thrive. The rocks absorb the sun's energy during the day and release it slowly, creating a natural greenhouse.

scenes.title_cn: 吐槽：果冻海还得看地中海
scenes.title_en: A Rant: For Jelly-Sea, Come to the Mediterranean
scenes.context: 博主小小吐槽：想看这样的果冻海一定要来看地中海，不要去看大西洋——他们在葡萄牙几乎天天遇到阴天。语域：吐槽+旅行经验。
sentences: 如果大家想看这样子的果冻海，一定要来看地中海好吗。
If you want to see jelly-sea like this, you must come to the Mediterranean, okay?
jelly-sea（果冻海，形容海水清澈）；you must come to（一定要来看）
不要去看那个大西洋。
Don't go looking for it in the Atlantic.
don't go looking for（别去看/别指望）
我们在葡萄牙几乎天天都是阴天。
In Portugal, it was overcast almost every single day.
overcast（阴天）；almost every single day（几乎天天）
paraphrase: 果冻海 → jelly-sea / crystal-clear turquoise water
jelly-sea · crystal-clear water
几乎天天 → almost every single day / nearly every day
almost every single day · nearly every day
scenes.speak: If you want to see jelly-sea like this, you must come to the Mediterranean, okay? Don't go looking for it in the Atlantic. In Portugal, it was overcast almost every single day.

scenes.context: 博主介绍中世纪北非海盗常来加泰罗尼亚海岸烧杀抢掠，所以人民建了防御海堡；现在堡上摆几个假大炮模拟当年打海盗。语域：历史趣谈。
sentences: 中世纪的时候，北非的海盗特别猖狂，他们总是来加泰罗尼亚海岸线上烧杀抢掠。
In the Middle Ages, North African pirates ran rampant, always coming to the Catalonia coast to raid and plunder.
run rampant（特别猖狂）；raid and plunder（烧杀抢掠）
所以这里的人民才会建这样的防御海堡。
That's why the people here built these defensive strongholds.
that's why（所以）；defensive stronghold（防御海堡）
我们每次看到军事防御的地方，他们就搞几个假大炮放在这里，给你模拟一下以前在这里打海盗。
Every military defense site we see has a few fake cannons set up to reenact how pirates were fought off here.
fake cannons（假大炮）；reenact（模拟再现）
paraphrase: 烧杀抢掠 → raid and plunder / pillage and burn
raid and plunder · pillage
模拟一下 → reenact / act out / recreate
reenact · act out
scenes.speak: In the Middle Ages, North African pirates ran rampant, always coming to the Catalonia coast to raid and plunder. That's why the people here built these defensive strongholds. Every military defense site we see has a few fake cannons set up to reenact how pirates were fought off here.

scenes.title_en: Closing: Mom Wants to Come Back
scenes.context: 博主和妈妈在地中海边吃完海鲜饭，妈妈表示以后想专门来这个小镇度假，本期到此结束。语域：轻松道别。
sentences: 我们坐下来了吃饭，我妈妈每次来地中海必吃的海鲜饭。
We sat down to eat, and my mom had the paella she always gets whenever we come to the Mediterranean.
the paella she always gets（必吃的海鲜饭）
妈妈说以后想专门来这个地方度假。
Mom said she wants to come back here on purpose for a vacation.
come back on purpose（专门再来）
这个小镇不是特别大，我们差不多玩完了，我们下期见。
The town isn't very big — we've basically seen it all. See you next episode.
seen it all（玩完了）；see you next episode（下期见）
paraphrase: 专门来 → come back on purpose / make a special trip
on purpose · a special trip
玩完了 → seen it all / done everything here
seen it all · done everything
scenes.speak: We sat down to eat, and my mom had the paella she always gets whenever we come to the Mediterranean. Mom said she wants to come back here on purpose for a vacation. The town isn't very big — we've basically seen it all. See you next episode.

practice: 介绍植物园的奇妙设计
The founder put cacti and rainforest plants together in one garden by the sea.
The rocks absorb the sun's heat by day and release it slowly, like a greenhouse.
If you want crystal-clear jelly-sea, come to the Mediterranean.
The townspeople built these walls because North African pirates raided the coast.
pitfalls: The plants live in the same place.
Over four thousand plant groups live together in one garden.
用具体数字 plant groups（植物类群）比泛泛 same place 更有信息量。
The rocks absorb heat by day and release it slowly.
makes heat 不通；吸收后缓慢释放是 absorb ... and release ...。
I want to see the ocean blue.
If you want to see the jelly-sea, come to the Mediterranean.
jelly-sea（果冻海）是形容清澈海水的形象说法，比 the ocean blue 更具体。
North African pirates ran rampant along the coast.
run rampant（猖獗）比 very bad 精准，表现海盗的肆无忌惮。
shifts: 用 botanical garden、cacti（仙人掌）、moisture-loving（喜湿）、plant groups（植物类群）
用 cliffside（悬崖边）、drain away（排水）、greenhouse（温室）、sea breeze（海风）
用 defensive stronghold（防御要塞）、fake cannons（假大炮）、fortified（设防）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：托萨→Tossa、布拉内斯→Blanes、加泰罗涅→加泰罗尼亚、果冬海→果冻海、清泡→海鲜饭、海宝→海堡 等
